en.title: E-commerce Platform
en.summary: Shop build, payments, and marketing analytics for Aurore Collection.
en.challenge: A new jewelry brand needed a credible online storefront and an operating model that connected discovery, checkout, fulfillment, analytics, and marketing experiments.
contribution: Owned the product from business model and site structure through launch, payments, content, and fulfillment.
Implemented analytics and conversion tracking to support marketing decisions.
Coordinated a lean remote team, vendors, and ongoing product operations.
technical: Responsive storefront and structured product content supported search, browsing, and checkout.
Payment, fulfillment, and analytics services formed the operational commerce stack.
Campaign and conversion signals fed iterative content and growth decisions.

architecture.label: Acquisition
architecture.detail: Social, campaign, and search traffic lands on product and collection content.

architecture.label: Storefront
architecture.detail: Responsive catalog, product detail, cart, and checkout guide purchase decisions.

architecture.label: Commerce services
architecture.detail: Payments, order handling, fulfillment, and customer communication support operations.

architecture.label: Learning loop
architecture.detail: Analytics and conversion tracking inform marketing and product iteration.

outcomes: Launched a complete commerce experience rather than only a brand site.
Demonstrated product ownership across design, implementation, operations, marketing, and team coordination.
Used evidence from analytics to guide growth experiments and conversion work.

zh.title: Aurore 電商平台
zh.summary: 為 Aurore Collection 建立商店、金流與成長分析。
zh.role: 共同創辦人、產品負責人與網站開發者
zh.challenge: 新創珠寶品牌需要可信賴的線上商店，以及串連品牌探索、結帳、履約、分析與行銷實驗的營運模式。
contribution: 從商業模式、網站架構到上線、金流、內容與履約，全程負責產品。
實作分析與轉換追蹤，支援行銷決策。
協調精實遠端團隊、供應商與日常產品營運。
technical: 響應式商店與結構化商品內容支援搜尋、瀏覽與結帳流程。
金流、履約與分析服務構成電商營運技術堆疊。
活動與轉換訊號回饋至內容迭代與成長決策。

architecture.label: 流量獲取
architecture.detail: 社群、廣告活動與搜尋流量導向商品及系列內容。

architecture.label: 商店前台
architecture.detail: 響應式目錄、商品詳情、購物車與結帳流程協助購買決策。

architecture.label: 商務服務
architecture.detail: 金流、訂單處理、履約與顧客溝通支援日常營運。

architecture.label: 學習迴圈
architecture.detail: 分析與轉換追蹤結果用於行銷及產品迭代。

outcomes: 推出完整電商體驗，而不只是品牌形象網站。
展現橫跨設計、實作、營運、行銷與團隊協調的產品負責能力。
以分析證據引導成長實驗與轉換優化。
